messages.subject: Penrose v Caldervale CL-2025-000287 - Particulars of Claim served
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Mr Greaves,

Proceedings having been issued, please find served herewith by email the (Amended) Particulars of Claim, sealed by the Court today, in Claim No. CL-2025-000287. The Schedule of Loss accompanies the Particulars. Hard copies follow by post.

We look forward to your client's Defence in due course.

Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP
